programme.title: Grandpas
programme.desc: Three entrepreneurial grandfathers face an uphill battle when they try to open a day care center.

programme.title: Corsage
programme.desc: An empress of Austria known for her beauty has trouble dealing with the fact that she is turning 40 soon and begins to question what people will think about her, so she begins to obsess about her weight, looks and other personal aspects.

programme.title: Ali
programme.desc: In 1964, a brash, new pro boxer, fresh from his Olympic gold medal victory, explodes onto the scene: Cassius Clay. Bold and outspoken, he cuts an entirely new image for African Americans in sport with his proud public self-confidence and his unapologetic belief that he is the greatest boxer of all time. Yet at the top of his game, both Ali's personal and professional lives face the ultimate test.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: A look at the life and career of the Hollywood actor, whose roles in Jaws, All That Jazz and The French Connection catapulted him to stardom.

programme.title: Monsieur Verdoux
programme.desc: Verdoux is an insignificant bank clerk who loses his job during the Great Depression. Soon, he devises a plan to marry old spinsters and murder them for their money.

programme.title: Golden Years
programme.desc: Fate, the pensions crisis and a steadfast refusal to accept the injustice of old age have contrived to force law abiding, retired couple, Arthur and Martha Goode into a life of crime. Refusing to take the loss of their pensions lying down and to fade away into their declining years, our characters decide to fight back. They decide to take back what was theirs in the first place. They decide to start robbing banks.

programme.title: Monty Python's Life Of Brian
programme.desc: Brian Cohen is an average young Jewish man, but through a series of ridiculous events, he gains a reputation as the Messiah. When he's not dodging his followers or being scolded by his shrill mother, the hapless Brian has to contend with the pompous Pontius Pilate and acronym-obsessed members of a separatist movement. Rife with Monty Python's signature absurdity, the tale finds Brian's life paralleling Biblical lore, albeit with many more laughs.

programme.title: The Commitments
programme.desc: Jimmy Rabbitte is a would-be music business wheeler and dealer, and he's decided what Dublin needs is a top-shelf soul band. However, top-shelf soul musicians are hard to find in Dublin, so he has to make do with what he can find. Before long, the band, called the Commitments, is packing them in at local clubs. Do they have what it takes to make the big time?

programme.title: Long Story Short
programme.desc: Ellen and her friends all dream of living in the perfect relationship with their one true match—but their real lives are far removed from these romantic ideals. We follow them over three years and eight parties, as they navigate countless complications and each experience their own emotional highs and lows in love.

programme.title: Unfaithful
programme.desc: Connie, a middle-aged wife and mother, has an affair with Paul, a handsome young Frenchman. When Connie's husband, Edward, becomes suspicious, he hires a private investigator. When his fears are confirmed, Edward confronts Paul in a decision that will come to haunt him.

programme.title: The House
programme.desc: 27-year-old French writer Emma immerses herself in Berlin's sex trade to research her novel. What begins as brief research becomes a two-year journey of desire, danger and discovery.

programme.title: Oink
programme.desc: A young girl sets out to prove to her disapproving mother she can house-train the endearing but unruly little piglet she gets as a birthday gift from her estranged oddball grandfather.

programme.title: A Great Friend
programme.desc: A man breaks down on the side of a mountain road. Another stops to offer help. A seemingly innocuous encounter that will prove to be a decisive turning point in each of their lives. Yet everything seems to oppose them. But, forced to live together for two days in the heart of spectacular nature, they will both stop lying to each other and finally find their smiles again. Thanks to each other. And what if their meeting wasn't by chance...

programme.title: The Orator
programme.desc: This acclaimed film is the first entirely shot in Samoa. Saili, a taro farmer, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status by proving his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community.

programme.title: A Singular Crime
programme.desc: Two young people in Rosario in the 80s, must do everything possible to solve the case of a missing man during a military dictatorship. As the country goes through a dark period, the police and the military go after the criminal mind behind a seemingly perfect crime, a kidnapping for ransom followed by the disappearance of any trace of the victim.

programme.title: In A Land That No Longer Exists
programme.desc: Exploring fashion in the former GDR, this film highlights iconic Sibylle magazine, state brand Exquisit, and the underground creative subculture behind East Germany's style scene.

programme.title: Vai
programme.desc: Vai is a film about female empowerment telling the story of one woman's life in eight separate moments from the perspective of eight different Pacific Island cultures. Beautifully shot, celebratory and epic, at times heartbreaking and uplifting, Vai is a seamless portmanteau film directed by eight female Pacific directors.

programme.title: Thunderbirds Are Go
programme.desc: When the launch of a mission to Mars goes awry due to sabotage, International Rescue is requested to assist in the mission's second attempt.

programme.title: Groundhog Day
programme.desc: Bill Murray is at his wry, wisecracking best in this riotous romantic comedy about a weatherman caught in a personal time warp on the worst day of his life. Teamed with a relentlessly cheerful producer and a smart-aleck cameraman, TV weatherman Phil Connors is sent to Punxsutawney, Pennsylvania, to cover the annual Groundhog Day festivities.

programme.title: The Full Monty
programme.desc: Six unemployed men from Sheffield decide to become strippers for one night only in a bid to raise extra money. However, with no dancing experience and far from perfect physiques, the men rely on the unique selling point of complete nudity to impress the punters. Comedy, starring Robert Carlyle, Mark Addy, Tom Wilkinson, Hugo Speer and Paul Barber.

programme.title: Late Night
programme.desc: A talk show host fears she is set to lose her long-running series, so takes steps to freshen up her programme. Comedy drama, with Emma Thompson and John Lithgow.

programme.title: Wild Seas
programme.desc: A woman works alongside her fisherman husband on an island off France's Atlantic coast but their happy existence is thrown into question by the arrival of a trainee.

programme.title: The Vourdalak
programme.desc: Lost in a hostile forest, the Marquis d'Urfe, a noble emissary of the King of France, finds refuge in the home of a strange family.
